turns.content: For the ordered nucleon isospin basis (p,n)^T, calculate tau_x+i tau_y from tau_x=[[0,1],[1,0]] and tau_y=[[0,-i],[i,0]]. How does it act on the proton and neutron basis states?
What nucleon transition does that operator action select before the emitted pion is considered?
Use charge conservation to determine the pion charge for that transition, taking Q(n)=0 and Q(p)=+1.
Write the resulting pion-emission process and connect the nucleon charge change to the pion charge.
Check the result directly against both the matrix action in the fixed (p,n)^T basis and charge conservation.
Give the final nucleon-pion process with a concise isospin and charge-conservation justification.
